caption: The drawing depicts a square textile or fabric design, with a predominantly beige background. The central motif features a green symmetrical leaf-like pattern radiating outward from the center. Surrounding the center, four large red shapes, each resembling a stylized fern or feather, are arranged diagonally toward the corners of the square, with the open side of each red shape facing inward. Interspersed between the large red shapes are further green, curved, smaller fern-like motifs that radiate and bend toward the edges. The entire design is framed by a border composed of alternating red and green triangles. The textile or drawing is shown against a plain background with faint framing lines and includes a small, hand-drawn scale in the lower left corner, denoting "32" by "32". The artist's notation, "V. Rosel," and additional numbers and words are handwritten near the bottom right corner.
title: Coverlet for Crib
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
